content: Lenacapavir has the potential to increase the plasma levels or pharmacological effects of drugs that are substrates of the hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. This interaction occurs due to its inhibitory effect on CYP3A4 metabolism. The following points summarize the clinical implications and necessary precautions for specific drugs: 1. General Precaution: Lenacapavir may increase the risk of adverse reactions associated with CYP3A4 substrates, particularly when these drugs are initiated within 9 months after the last subcutaneous dose of lenacapavir. Close monitoring is recommended in such cases. 2. Specific Drug Interactions: Sufentanil: Lenacapavir increases sufentanil levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Sunitinib: Lenacapavir elevates sunitinib levels. Close monitoring is required. Suvolexant: Lenacapavir increases suvolexant levels. Monitor closely for potential adverse effects. Tacrolimus: Lenacapavir raises tacrolimus levels. Use caution and monitor closely. Tadalafil: Lenacapavir significantly increases tadalafil levels. Avoid coadministration or use alternative drugs. Refer to PDE5 inhibitor prescribing information for dose adjustments. Tamoxifen: Lenacapavir increases tamoxifen levels. Monitor closely. Tamsulosin: Lenacapavir elevates tamsulosin levels. Use caution and monitor closely. Tasimelteon: Lenacapavir increases tasimelteon levels. Monitor closely. Telotristat Ethyl: Telotristat ethyl decreases lenacapavir levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use alternative drugs. Temsirolimus: Lenacapavir increases temsirolimus levels. Monitor closely. Teniposide: Lenacapavir elevates teniposide levels. Use caution and monitor closely. Tetracycline: Lenacapavir increases tetracycline levels. Monitor closely. Tezacaftor: Lenacapavir raises tezacaftor levels. Use caution and monitor closely. Theophylline: Lenacapavir increases theophylline levels. Monitor closely. Tiagabine: Lenacapavir elevates tiagabine levels. Use caution and monitor closely. Ticagrelor: Lenacapavir increases ticagrelor levels. Monitor closely. Ticlopidine: Lenacapavir raises ticlopidine levels. Use caution and monitor closely. Tinidazole: Lenacapavir increases tinidazole levels. Monitor closely. Tipranavir/Ritonavir: Coadministration with lenacapavir may result in loss of therapeutic effect and resistance development. Avoid coadministration. Tisotumab Vedotin: Lenacapavir increases tisotumab vedotin levels. Monitor closely. Tofacitinib: Lenacapavir elevates tofacitinib levels. Use caution and monitor closely. Tolterodine: Lenacapavir increases tolterodine levels. Monitor closely. Tolvaptan: Lenacapavir raises tolvaptan levels. Use caution and monitor closely. Toremifene: Lenacapavir increases toremifene levels. Monitor closely. Trabectedin: Lenacapavir elevates trabectedin levels. Use caution and monitor closely. Tramadol: Lenacapavir increases tramadol levels. Dose adjustment for tramadol may be required. Monitor closely. Trazodone: Lenacapavir raises trazodone levels. Use caution and monitor closely. Triazolam: Lenacapavir increases triazolam levels. Monitor closely. Trimethoprim: Lenacapavir elevates trimethoprim levels. Use caution and monitor closely. Trimipramine: Lenacapavir increases trimipramine levels. Monitor closely. Tucatinib: Lenacapavir raises tucatinib levels. Use caution and monitor closely. Ulipristal: Lenacapavir increases ulipristal levels. Monitor closely. Upadacitinib: Lenacapavir elevates upadacitinib levels. Use caution and monitor closely. Valbenazine: Lenacapavir increases valbenazine levels. Monitor closely. Vandetanib: Lenacapavir raises vandetanib levels. Use caution and monitor closely. Vardenafil: Lenacapavir increases vardenafil levels. Dose reduction may be necessary. Monitor closely. Velpatasvir: Lenacapavir elevates velpatasvir levels. Use caution and monitor closely. Vemurafenib: Lenacapavir increases vemurafenib levels. Monitor closely. Venetoclax: Lenacapavir raises venetoclax levels. Use caution and monitor closely. Venlafaxine: Lenacapavir increases venlafaxine levels. Monitor closely. Verapamil: Lenacapavir elevates verapamil levels. Use caution and monitor closely. Vilanterol/Fluticasone Furoate (Inhaled): Lenacapavir increases levels of these drugs. Monitor closely. Vilazodone: Lenacapavir raises vilazodone levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 3. General Recommendation: For all drugs metabolized by CYP3A4, clinicians should exercise caution when coadministering lenacapavir. Adjustments to drug dosages or alternative therapies may be necessary to mitigate the risk of adverse effects.
